svg.title: Parameterisation progression: from lookup tables to shared-parameter functions
svg.desc: A flow diagram. A full lookup table with |V|^m parameters is crossed out because it cannot generalize. Two escapes lead from it: Escape A assumes structure and shrinks the table to |V| parameters per class (Naive Bayes, n-grams); Escape B parameterizes the model with a shared-parameter function f theta, shown as three stages: linear logistic regression, a neural network and a transformer.
